Summary of the current run, from the monitoring assistant that watched the instruments:

The temperature has stabilized near seven hundred fifty degrees Celsius. Heater power is holding around forty-six percent after decreasing from its peak during the ramp. Argon flow is steady at one hundred standard cubic centimeters per minute, and pressure remains stable around three point one Torr. Exhaust oxygen levels are low and consistent. All specified sensors are installed and recording.
